title: Etna Campaign Result
description: Output format produced by the `solve`, `test`, and `shrink` capabilities. A single JSON object summarizing the outcome of a campaign (or a single test / shrink invocation). The driver also expects this shape from the consumer side of a `Cross` run.

tests.description: Number of inputs that were run against the property.

discarded.description: Number of inputs that were generated and then discarded (e.g. failed a precondition).

shrinks.description: Number of shrink steps performed to minimize the counterexample. Only meaningful when status = found_bug or for the `shrink` capability.

time.description: Total wall-clock time spent, as a human-readable duration (e.g. "1.5s", "250ms", "123ns"). Parsed with the `parse_duration` crate.

counterexample.description: Opaque minimized-or-raw input that witnessed the failure. Present iff status = found_bug. The encoding is workload-specific and must match the `input-stream.schema.json` `value` shape so it can be fed back into `test` / `shrink`.

error.description: Free-form error message. Typically present when status = aborted.

status_reason.description: Optional human-readable reason, e.g. the assertion message that produced status = found_bug.
